title: TEXAS：面向下游MoE大模型适配的任务专家感知监督
summary: TEXAS提出一种新方法，通过正确性条件化的专家发现和令牌级监督分配，利用MoE模型的路由行为提升下游微调性能。在三个MoE模型和六个基准上，17/18设置达到最佳或并列最佳，平均提升1.3-1.5点。
summary_en: TEXAS introduces a method combining correctness-conditioned expert discovery with token-level supervision allocation, leveraging MoE routing behavior for downstream fine-tuning. It achieves best or tied-best performance in 17/18 settings across three MoE models and six benchmarks, improving by 1.3-1.5 points on average.
